artDirection.backgroundPrompt:
A stylized Counter-Strike 2 character positioned center-right of the canvas, captured mid-action in a dynamic tactical stance. The character is a skilled operative wearing modern tactical gear - dark navy combat uniform with orange accent stripes and purple utility pouches, tactical helmet with visor, and body armor. They're gripping a sleek assault rifle in a professional shooting position, finger on trigger guard, weapon angled diagonally across their body. The character's pose suggests they're clearing a corner or advancing through a competitive map. Bold solid color fills with dramatic cast shadows creating depth - no gradients or soft photographic shading. The illustration style matches CB's premium vector aesthetic: clean sharp edges, stylized proportions slightly heroic, and high contrast lighting. Dynamic low-angle perspective looking slightly up at the operative, creating an impressive competitive gaming feel. Subtle geometric fragments and tactical HUD-style elements float around the character, suggesting digital interfaces and gaming overlays. Color palette emphasizes CB brand colors: deep purple shadows (#300931), electric orange highlights (#FF6B2F), navy uniform base (#0F1032), with white tactical gear accents. The composition leaves generous space on the left side for text overlay, with the character cleanly cut against the template background for perfect compositing.

From illustration-01: Borrow the dynamic action pose with clean vector illustration style, bold color blocking, and dramatic shadow casting technique. From illustration-03: Use the bold graphic vector art style with simplified forms, clean geometric shapes, and strong contrast against dark backgrounds. From illustration-06: Apply the flat design approach with minimal shading, contemporary sports graphic style, and clean geometric character forms. From slide-3-twitter-new: Reference the tactical character styling, flat illustration technique with clean lines, and the gaming-focused aesthetic with angular background integration.
